component.name: Bassdrive Radio
component.summary: Stream Bassdrive 24/7 Drum & Bass radio and archived shows

description.p: Bassdrive Radio is an open-source player for Bassdrive Internet radio (24/7 Drum & Bass) and its weekly show archive.

ul.li: Listen to the 24/7 live broadcast with live show metadata
Browse archived shows by broadcast day with instant search
Save favourite episodes and automatically resume where you left off
Cache episodes for offline listening with storage management
